items.label: Iran/Hormuz -- Lloyd's List's 477-transit claim still unconfirmed and now contradicted further; new Oct 11 UKMTO incidents; week of Sep 28-Oct 5 was the highest tanker-attack week of the war
items.detail: Live web research (background-delegated): lloydslistintelligence.com failed WebFetch again this run (DNS/proxy error, same failure as 10-14), and no secondary outlet independently repeated the 477-non-Iranian-transit figure cited in the 10-12 Lloyd's List brief. New incident data: UKMTO issued 4 time-late reports on Oct 11 (3 tankers + 1 container ship); Reuters (Oct 7) reported >=12 tanker attacks near the strait in the week of Sep 28-Oct 5, the highest single week since the war's Feb 2026 start; a drone strike left 2 Indian seafarers missing (Oct 11, via Gulf News); a tanker off Qatar was hit by multiple projectiles with casualties (Oct 8). Joint Maritime Information Center rates the strait's threat level "severe" as of Oct 12. Brent crude $103.63 (Oct 12, straits.live), -1.04% on the day. DBC buffer ($43,436.24, 9.14% of NAV) held unchanged against this tail risk.

Fed's policy rate is 3.75%-4.00% (hiked Sept 16, 2026, per usagold.com). Gold spot $4,177.28/oz (Oct 12, usagold.com, -0.42% that day) -- essentially flat vs. 10-09's $4,175, no post-CPI gold reaction yet located.
